# 5x Faster Headless Test Creation Within Your IDE: How AURA Turns Days of Test Authoring Into Minutes

Test authoring that used to take days now takes minutes — without leaving your IDE.

![Carlos Carvajal](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6a2d0f4994c335fd3fa089e0/6a6a87b3402f79596f8905ee_Carlos.avif)

Carlos Carvajal

Senior Product Marketing Manager

August 20, 2026

AI can now write code faster than any team can verify it’s safe to ship. Engineering velocity has outpaced test coverage industrywide, and verification still lags behind — one test, one selector, one manual review at a time. That mismatch is the AI code verification gap, and it’s already stalling releases and burning out engineering teams.

[Sauce Labs AURA](https://saucelabs.com/products) closes that gap. It’s an AI-unified release assurance platform that brings test authoring, device cloud execution, visual testing, and release insights into a single workflow, so verification finally moves at the speed that AI generates code.

Here’s what that looks like inside your IDE: Write one line of intent — enter a $500 deposit, click confirm, verify the deposit was made. AURA authors the test in your framework of choice, then executes it on real-world devices in Sauce Labs’ hosted device clouds. No flying headless into a release you can't verify.

Can you use Claude Code or Copilot to generate and run tests, or do you need a platform like Sauce Labs AURA? Claude Code and Copilot can generate and run tests. But they don’t provide the scalable infrastructure, cross-browser and real-device coverage, or centralized test analysis of a platform like Sauce Labs AURA. AURA also enables technical and non-technical users to create tests from business intent through the IDE, MCP, or Sauce UI. Coding assistants accelerate test creation; AURA delivers scalable, continuous release assurance.

Days of authoring, minutes to build. Minutes to build, seconds to run. See it in action:

The old model didn't fail. AI just outgrew it.
